parameters.query: SELECT vacancy_id, code, title, department, status, priority, work_mode, location, seniority_level, openings, contract_type, minimum_experience_months, minimum_education, education_required, closes_at, published_at, total_postulaciones FROM talentflow.vw_bot_vacantes WHERE vacancy_id::text = $1 OR code ILIKE $1 OR title ILIKE '%'||$1||'%' LIMIT 5
